title: Moose Items
description: This pack adds 3D items in the MooseBlocks Style. Hand designed models and textures to bring some Moosified whimsey to your world!
body:
# You're Telling Me a Moose Made these Items?
Yes, Yes I am, although a Cosmic Moose would be more accurate. This is an addon pack for my other project MooseBlocks, made with the same intent to bring a blend of minimal and stylized design to your Minecraft world... With a heaping spoonful of whimsey to go along with it! If you enjoy my packs, please join the discord server and give feedback so I can improve them! 
## Key Features
- Custom 3D models for all weapons and tools. (99% only missing lead)
- 3D models and eating and drinking animations for food (89% all foods added some do not have eating animations)
- 3D models for music discs. (100%)
- 3D models for armor trims and pottery sherds (100%)
- 3D models for ingredients (99%)
- 3D models and enchantment specific textures for books (100%)
- Minimal armor textures designed to show off your skin without hiding armor completely (WIP)

## Upcoming Features
- Add support for Punchy
- Custom Models for renamed items for decoration
- Add glowing enchantment outlines (Waiting to start work on this until Vibrant Visuals is on Java and Mojang offers an officially supported way to modify core shaders. For now the enchantment outlines mod works great with the pack.
- Add Mod Support
  - Traveler's Backpacks
  - Farmer's Delight
  - Dungeons and Taverns
